build_ConvTBC_module: build a ConvTBC 1D convolution module with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size
create_ConvTBC_with_padding: create a ConvTBC convolution layer with custom padding for time-major input tensors
run_ConvTBC_forward: run the ConvTBC forward pass on a time x batch x channel input tensor
test_ConvTBC_reset_parameters: test the ConvTBC reset_parameters method to reinitialize weights with Xavier normal and zero bias
review_ConvTBC_conv_tbc: review the ConvTBC conv_tbc method that performs GEMM-based 1D convolution using torch.conv_tbc
